## Polynomial Regression


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mod1 <- lm(mpg~weight, data=Auto)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 1, 0))  # oma: bottom, left, top, right
plot(mod1, sub.caption="")
mtext("Figure 2", outer = TRUE, cex = 1)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](exam126output_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672}
:::

```{.r .cell-code}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))  # reset to defaults
glance(mod1) |>
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}


| r.squared| adj.r.squared|      AIC|      BIC|
|---------:|-------------:|--------:|--------:|
|     0.693|         0.692| 2265.939| 2277.852|


:::
